_meta.description: Real-data test cases for LLM eligibility prompt. Each case covers a distinct scenario the system encounters. Source: e-GP Bangladesh snapshots + BracIT capability profile.

cases._scenario: ELIGIBLE — strong IT match, all rules pass, urgency (closes in 4 days)

tender.title: Supply, Installation and Implementation of Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) for Directorate General of Health Services
tender.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
tender.description: Supply, installation, configuration and go-live support of a Hospital Management Information System covering patient registration, OPD, IPD, pharmacy, laboratory, billing and HR modules for 64 district hospitals.
tender.eligibilityText: The tenderer must have ISO 9001 quality management certification. Minimum annual turnover BDT 50,000,000 (Five Crore) for last 3 years. The tenderer must have successfully completed at least one similar MIS implementation for a government health organization.

evidence.profileText: Health information systems and eHealth platforms
Management information system (MIS) design, development and rollout
National social protection beneficiary management system. Design and rollout of a beneficiary registration, targeting and payment reconciliation MIS serving several million households.

tender.title: Procurement of Enterprise Software Development Services for National Digital Transformation Programme
tender.ministry: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology
tender.description: Development of enterprise-grade digital services platform including mobile applications, API gateway, cloud-native microservices and integration with national identity infrastructure.
tender.eligibilityText: The tenderer must hold CMMI for Development Level 5 certification. ISO/IEC 27001 information security certification is mandatory. Minimum average annual turnover BDT 500,000,000 (Fifty Crore) for the last 3 fiscal years. At least 3 successfully completed e-governance projects in the last 5 years.

evidence.profileText: Cloud migration and cloud managed services

blockingGaps.message: Missing CMMI5. BracIT holds CMMI3. Would qualify once Level 5 is obtained or if Level 3 is accepted.

tender.title: Supply and Installation of Desktop Computers, Laptops, Printers and Networking Equipment for District Education Offices
tender.procuringEntity: Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education
tender.organization: Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education
tender.description: Supply, delivery and installation of 500 desktop computers, 200 laptops, 150 printers and structured network cabling for 64 district education offices across Bangladesh.
tender.eligibilityText: Minimum annual turnover BDT 30,000,000 (Three Crore). Must be an authorized dealer/distributor of the supplied brands. Trade license and VAT registration required.

cases._scenario: VERIFY — geography rule unknown (World Bank tender, country partially stated)

tender.title: Digital Financial Services Platform Development and Integration — South Asia Regional Programme
tender.procuringEntity: Bangladesh Bank (on behalf of South Asia Finance Ministers Forum)
tender.description: Design, development and integration of a regional digital financial services platform covering mobile payments, cross-border remittance, agent banking and regulatory reporting APIs for three South Asian central banks.
tender.eligibilityText: Firms must have ISO/IEC 27001 certification. Minimum average annual turnover USD 5,000,000 equivalent for last 3 years. At least 2 completed digital financial services or core banking implementation projects in the last 5 years. Open to firms from World Bank member countries.

evidence.profileText: Financial technology and digital financial services platforms
Core banking and microfinance system implementation
Digital financial services and mobile wallet integration. Development of payment orchestration and mobile wallet integration services.

verifyGaps.message: Tender country is 'Regional — Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka'. BracIT covers Bangladesh and South Asia but the multi-country scope needs manual confirmation that a Bangladeshi firm may lead.

Turnover threshold stated in USD. Conversion to BDT needed to confirm: USD 5,000,000 ≈ BDT 550,000,000 at current rates. BracIT turnover BDT 1,200,000,000 appears sufficient but FX rate should be verified.

cases._scenario: BID — very strong match, staffing tender but with software delivery component, medium urgency

tender.title: Provision of Dedicated Software Engineering, QA and Infrastructure Teams for Government Digital Service Delivery Unit
tender.procuringEntity: ICT Division, Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and IT
tender.ministry: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology
tender.description: Multi-year engagement for a firm to provide dedicated software engineers, QA specialists and DevOps engineers embedded within the government digital service delivery unit, with structured knowledge transfer to government counterpart staff.
tender.eligibilityText: Minimum annual average turnover BDT 100,000,000 (Ten Crore) in the last 3 fiscal years. ISO 9001 certification required. CMMI Level 3 or above preferred. Firm must have completed at least 2 similar embedded team engagements for government clients.

evidence.profileText: Dedicated software engineering and QA teams embedded with client delivery units

Embedded software engineering and QA delivery teams. Multi-year provision of dedicated software engineers, quality assurance specialists and infrastructure engineers working inside client delivery teams.
Technical training and knowledge transfer for software and systems teams
